items.title: feat(multi-user): add provider-neutral connected accounts (#134970)
items.summary: feat(multi-user): add provider-neutral connected accounts (#134970) Unify personal provider accounts across Connected accounts, the CLI and the chat/New session model picker. Provider plugins own supported sign-in methods; the Gateway owns the initiating human connection, private credentials/defaults and session selection. Custodian hands setup to the protected UI or CLI. Preserve existing session pins and capture defaults only at creation. Carry the original operation's live assertion into provider authentication and the shared final-dispatch hook, after DNS/proxy preparation and on every redirect. Keep cancellation and final synchronous credential-store fencing as separate guards. Reuse identity-secret storage without a new schema or configuration surface. Repair account pagination, clipped guidance, stale navigation and cancelled PTY construction. Preserve Dashboard iframe identity across pane transitions and close only the retired model-catalog request's worker pool. Adopt main's canonical node withheld-permission producer for hot policy-denial guidance. Exact-head proof includes a clean build,319 focused auth tests, real-Gateway held-token/poll revocation with zero forbidden requests/writes and successful fresh controls, and a real-Gateway browser policy replay. The PR preserves sanitized before/after screenshots and separately attributed historical proof. Account selection is not a billing receipt. Anthropic setup is API-key only; native subscription credentials are not imported. Fresh MFA-gated OAuth remains unverified. Inherited SOCKS transport issue #131354 has separate repair #131436. Co-authored-by: scoootscooob Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger

Keep follow intent independent of viewport geometry and remove the transcript inset and overlay. Cover short, overflowing, near-fitting, resized and large-font histories while preserving header touch targets and composer geometry. Follow-up to #134939. * docs(android): correct composer line limit

items.title: WatchGuard修補5項重大漏洞，3項可讓未經身分驗證的攻擊者遠端執行程式碼
items.summary: 網路防火牆廠商WatchGuard於8月27日修補多項安全漏洞，其中部分漏洞可讓未經身分驗證的遠端攻擊者在受影響設備上執行任意程式碼，官方呼籲用戶儘速更新。

items.summary: 資料保護軟體廠商Nakivo繼上半年發布Backup & Replication 11.2與11.2.1版之後，近日又推出最新11.2.2版，進一步擴展對於虛擬化平臺與作業系統的備份保護支援。

items.title: Dropbox傳出遭駭，5千個帳號外洩
items.summary: 根據路透社報導，雲端檔案共享平臺Dropbox於8月31日向約5千名用戶發出通知，他們的帳號曾在8月4日至21日期間出現未經授權的存取，其中有不到三分之一的用戶檔案遭到駭客存取。

items.title: CISA警告SonicWall、JFrog Artifactory、LiteLLM等系統的已知漏洞遭到利用
items.summary: 9月2日美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）更新已遭利用的漏洞名單（KEV），指出他們掌握7個新漏洞遭到積極利用的證據，這些漏洞是：VoIP電話管理平臺Sangoma Switchvox的SQL注入漏洞CVE-2026-9586，非同步伺服器閘道介面（ASGI）網頁框架Kludex Starlette的HTTP請求或回應走私漏洞CVE-2026-48710，資料、AI與基礎架構工作流程事件驅動調度平臺Kestra的作業系統指令注入漏洞CVE-2026-49869，AI閘道BerriAI LiteLLM
